title: Out of Site: Empowering a New Approach to Online Boycotts
reasoning: The paper makes a primary contribution to design ethics by introducing and evaluating 'heuristic preventative design' (HPD). This methodology is used to identify and mitigate negative ethical impacts, such as preventing the system from being used to facilitate boycotts against religious or ethnic minorities. It treats these ethical considerations as a core design priority rather than a secondary limitation.
